name: Canadian Hydrographic Service IWLS water levels and tide predictions
short: Canadian coastal and St. Lawrence water level, observed and predicted, from CHS. Non-commercial licence.
summary: The Canadian Hydrographic Service (Fisheries and Oceans Canada) serves water-level time series through the Integrated Water Level System API at api-iwls.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/api/v1. Stations list their time series (wlo observed official value, wlp predictions, wlp-hilo high and low waters). On 2026-11-07 a keyless call for Point Atkinson, BC returned 1-minute predicted values (4.095 m at 12:00Z, flagged unreviewed). The wlo observed series for that station returned reviewed values for 4 to 6 November but an empty list for the last hours of 7 November, so observed data lag the call time. The licence agreement is restrictive: it forbids commercial derivative products, navigation use and passing the data to third parties.

tasks: predicted water level (m) and high and low waters at a Canadian tide station
official reviewed observed water level at a station, a few days behind

coverage.notes: Stations on the Atlantic, Pacific, Arctic and St. Lawrence coasts; the station list carries a code, operating flag and time series. Observed official values showed a lag of under a day on the one station tested.

rate_limit.notes: Also up to 3 requests per second; data window caps per request.

delivery.basis: Tested 2026-11-07 ~19:20Z: wlo had data to 6 Nov and nothing for 17:00-19:30Z on 7 Nov; wlp predictions covered the current day.

latency.typical: Observed values: about a day (reviewed); predictions are ahead of time

freshness.typical_age: About a day for observed values
freshness.notes: Stations differ in series offered; Point Atkinson offers wlo, wlp, wlp-hilo.

licensing.summary: Use is governed by the CHS Licence Agreement (tides.gc.ca/en/licence-agreement), which the API page says you accept by using the API. Key terms: CHS keeps the copyright; the data must not be used to produce derivative products for commercial purposes, sale or profit; must not be used for navigation; copyright must not be sold, licensed or given to a third party; a derivative product must carry the notice set in the agreement (not for navigation, contains CHS data, no endorsement). Treat this as non-commercial use only. AI training is not addressed.

time.method: Each record carries its own timestamp.
time.unknown: Timestamp is the provider's own stamp.

location.method: Fixed station or event coordinates in the feed.

content.method: Series are labelled reviewed or not and carry a QC flag code.
content.unknown: QC flag meanings were not checked.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments or official analysis, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

endpoints.notes: Call made. Station id, coordinates, operating flag, time series list.
Call made. Window cap is 1 week at 1-minute data.

api.rate_limits: Per client IP: up to 3 requests per second and 30 per minute; 1-minute data limited to 1 week per request, 3-minute data to 3 weeks, others to 1 month. A 429 means a limit was exceeded.
api.notes: JSON. Calls in this card were spaced several seconds apart.
